This notification relates to the vesting of Equity Rights (ERs) under the Woodside Equity Plan during the quarter ending 30
September 2026. These ERs were allocated before March 2024 under the WDSAE: WEP Equity Rights class. ERs
allocated from March 2024 onwards are allocated under the WDSAL: Rights class and will vest or lapse under the
WDSAL: Rights class.
